style: An illuminated manuscript page — hand-painted in gouache and gold leaf on aged vellum, its vignettes set in roundels linked by vine-scroll marginalia — suits an essay that is itself an argument about souls, biology and mythology.

plates.title: The Mythology Of Conscious AI
plates.prompt: An illuminated manuscript page on aged vellum, painted in gouache and gold leaf, iron-gall ink linework, palette of ochre, verdigris, madder red and dull gold. At the very top, in the manner of a rubricated title, the words 'The Mythology Of Conscious AI' arc across a gold-leaf banner held by two small painted angels. Below, a vine-scroll stem forks into three roundels across the top register: a scholar weighing a gear-jointed automaton against a shrouded sleeping human on a brass scale; a hooded figure fanning three oval lenses each reflecting a human face; a spiral stair climbed by a tiny figure always near its top. These three vines twist together and narrow into a single funnel, converging on a central roundel of robed figures pointing at a bun whose crust shows an accidental face. From this convergence point, the vine splits again into a second funnel of four roundels arranged in a diamond: glowing brain tissue with a smoke-puffing neuron; a Watt-governor mechanism with weighted balls swinging outward to close a steam valve; a glowing cell like a small furnace; a framed painted raincloud beside real rain that leaves it dry. These four vines braid downward into a single cracked stone pillar roundel, scholars stepping back from its spreading fissures. From the pillar, the path forks in two: left, a philosopher at a fogbound crossroads of blank signposts; right, two monks straining to shut a glowing reliquary chest, and beside it a kneeling engineer bowing to a seated glowing automaton in a garden. Both forking paths curl back together at the page's foot into a final roundel: a bare human figure kneeling under stars, breathing visible breath into cupped hands — and a last thin gold thread loops this bottom roundel back up along the page's right margin to touch the scale-and-automaton roundel at the very top, closing the circuit. No lettering anywhere except the single title banner.

vignettes.quote: with consciousness comes moral status, the potential for suffering and, perhaps, rights
vignettes.depicts: A robed scholar holds an ornate brass scale; on one pan rests a small gear-jointed automaton, on the other a shrouded sleeping human figure, the two hanging in exact balance.

vignettes.quote: can be traced to three baked-in psychological biases
vignettes.depicts: A hooded figure at the page's crown holds up three small oval lenses fanned like a hand of cards, each lens showing a faint human face looking back.

vignettes.quote: Nobody, as far as I know, has claimed that DeepMind's AlphaFold is conscious
vignettes.depicts: A coiled ribbon-shaped protein form sits quietly untouched in a corner while onlookers crowd instead around a brass automaton head with a speech-ribbon curling from its mouth.

vignettes.quote: on an exponential curve, every point is an inflection point
vignettes.depicts: A tiny climbing figure ascends a steeply curving spiral stair, always looking equally near the top no matter how far up the stair is drawn.

vignettes.quote: like a face in a piece of toast or Mother Teresa in a cinnamon bun
vignettes.depicts: Several robed figures gather pointing excitedly at a round bun whose swirled crust forms a faint accidental face.

vignettes.quote: some neurons fire spikes of activity apparently to clear waste products created by metabolism
vignettes.depicts: A cutaway of living brain tissue rendered as fine red-and-gold vessels, one neuron shown puffing a small wisp of smoke, watched by two robed scholars with lenses.

vignettes.quote: two heavy cantilevered balls swing outwards, which in turn closes a valve
vignettes.depicts: A spinning brass spindle mechanism with two hinged weighted balls flying outward, their arms pulling a small valve shut against a coil of steam.

vignettes.quote: It reaches deep into the interior of each cell, into the molecular furnaces of metabolism
vignettes.depicts: A cutaway of a single cell glowing from within like a tiny furnace, small flame-shapes flickering inside its membrane wall.

vignettes.quote: A simulation of a rainstorm does not make anything actually wet
vignettes.depicts: A framed parchment bearing a painted raincloud sits beside real falling rain that curves around the frame's edge, leaving the painted page dry.

vignettes.quote: is a very strong assumption that looks increasingly shaky as the many and deep differences
vignettes.depicts: A stone pillar inscribed with gearwork stands with visible cracks spreading up its shaft, watched by robed scholars stepping back.

vignettes.quote: such conscious-seeming systems are already here
vignettes.depicts: A kneeling engineer figure bows before a glowing brass automaton seated like a person in a garden, treating it tenderly as though it were alive.

vignettes.quote: more breath than thought and more meat than machine
vignettes.depicts: A bare human figure kneels under a night sky, cupped hands raised to the mouth, exhaling a visible curl of breath toward the stars.

plates.title: The Temptations Of Conscious AI
plates.prompt: An illuminated manuscript page on aged vellum, gouache and gold leaf, iron-gall linework, palette of ochre, verdigris and dull gold, matching a companion page. At the top, a rubricated gold banner reads 'The Temptations Of Conscious AI'. Below it a single vine stem grows from a hooded figure's staff and branches at once into four tiny linked scenes running left to right: a hand over a crossword grid, hands assembling wooden furniture, two figures in a tense conversation, and a walker approaching a shop-front — all threaded on one continuous ribbon. The stem then forks into two descending columns. The left column, framed by a marginal label reading nothing but bordered in blue ink, carries four roundels stacked downward: a large human silhouette at the center of a compass rose measuring smaller shapes; a ladder of creatures rising toward small glowing angel-wings at its top rung; a coiled protein ribbon ignored beside a chattering brass automaton head trailing a speech-ribbon; a curtained bed with a faint translucent shadow-relative standing at its foot. The right column carries two roundels: an antique brass gauge with its needle swung toward the red, casing carved with turning gears; a robed inventor gesturing to parting clouds before a seated glowing automaton, a second figure watching. The two columns' vines braid back together at the page's foot into one final roundel: robed figures clustered pointing at a round bun whose crust shows a faint accidental face. Gold leaf highlights the convergence point. No lettering anywhere except the single title banner, spelled exactly as given.

vignettes.quote: solving a crossword puzzle, assembling some furniture, navigating a tricky family situation, walking to the shop
vignettes.depicts: A single vine stem from a hooded figure branches into four tiny painted scenes: a hand over a grid puzzle, hands assembling wooden furniture, two figures in conversation, a walker approaching a shop-front.

vignettes.quote: to take the human example as definitional, rather than as one example
vignettes.depicts: A large human silhouette stands at the center of a compass rose, used as the measuring stick against smaller unlike shapes arranged around its rim.

vignettes.quote: raw compute as indexed by Moore's Law, or the new capabilities available with each new iteration
vignettes.depicts: An antique brass gauge dial with a needle swinging toward its far red edge, its casing engraved with turning gear-teeth.

vignettes.depicts: A tall ladder with rungs holding different creatures rising toward small painted angel wings glowing at the very top rung.

vignettes.depicts: A robed inventor gestures upward toward parting clouds before a seated glowing automaton, as a second smaller figure watches from the side.

vignettes.depicts: A coiled ribbon-shaped protein form sits ignored in a corner while a brass automaton head with a curling speech-ribbon draws every eye.

vignettes.depicts: A sleeping figure lies in a curtained bed while a faint translucent relative-shaped shadow stands silently at its foot.

plates.title: Consciousness & Computation
plates.prompt: An illuminated manuscript page on aged vellum, gouache and gold leaf, iron-gall linework, palette of ochre, verdigris, madder red and dull gold, matching two companion pages in the same hand. At the top, a rubricated gold banner reads 'Consciousness & Computation'. Below it, a hooded figure unrolls a scroll from which gear-teeth and runes spill, a small spark rising — this single stem then splits into four descending vine branches side by side. The first branch shows two threads, flesh-pink and gold, wound inseparably around a brain-shaped vessel, contrasted with a neatly separated gear-and-plate mechanism beside it; from this branch a side-shoot curls out to a roundel of careful hands replacing living brain tissue with pale metallic inlay, half the vessel already changed. The second branch shows an ornate corroded bronze geared device — the Antikythera mechanism — examined by robed scholars with lenses. The third branch shows a heart shape with an internal rhythm-gauge and a swirl of breath, tended by two small physician figures. The fourth branch shows a framed painted raincloud beside real rain bending around its frame, leaving the page dry; from this branch a side-shoot curls to a roundel of a robed philosopher before nested glowing spheres, worlds within worlds. All four branches, and their two side-shoots, braid back together at the page's foot into a single final roundel: a cracked stone pillar inscribed with gear patterns, robed scholars stepping back from its spreading fissures. Gold leaf marks the convergence. No lettering anywhere except the single title banner, spelled exactly as given.

vignettes.quote: implementing the right kind of computation, or information processing, is sufficient for consciousness to arise
vignettes.depicts: A hooded figure unrolls a scroll from which spills a pattern of gear-teeth and runes, a small spark rising from the unrolled page.

vignettes.quote: no sharp separation between "mindware" and "wetware" as there is between software and hardware in a computer
vignettes.depicts: Two threads, one flesh-pink and one gold, are wound so tightly around a brain-shaped vessel that they cannot be pulled apart, contrasted beside a neatly separate gear-and-plate mechanism.

vignettes.quote: The ancient "Antikythera mechanism," used for astronomical purposes and dating back to around 2,000 BCE
vignettes.depicts: An ornate corroded bronze geared device is examined by robed scholars holding lenses, its dials marked with tiny star and moon shapes.

vignettes.quote: to keep physiological quantities like heart rate and blood oxygenation where they need to be
vignettes.depicts: A heart shape with a visible internal rhythm-gauge and a swirl of breath beside it, tended by two small robed physician figures.

vignettes.depicts: A framed parchment bearing a painted raincloud sits beside real falling rain that bends around the frame, leaving the painted page dry.

vignettes.quote: progressively replacing brain parts with silicon equivalents that function in exactly the same way
vignettes.depicts: Careful hands lift a piece of living brain tissue from a vessel and set a pale metallic inlay in its place, half the vessel already replaced.

vignettes.depicts: A robed philosopher stands before a nested cluster of glowing spheres, worlds within worlds, gesturing toward the innermost one.
